ThingDef.label: Prim'ta larva
ThingDef.description: An immature Goa'uld symbiote intended for implantation into a compatible Jaffa abdominal pouch. This living resource is consumed by the Jaffa Prim'ta implantation procedure. It must now be preserved in cold storage: warm conditions cause progressive deterioration and a fully rotted larva is destroyed. Natural acquisition and maturation systems are still early prototypes.
